# timer

```go
import "github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/timer"
```

Package timer counts a time down a step per tick and says when it runs out. The time comes from its ticks, never from reading the clock.

<a name="Styles"></a>
## type [Styles](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/timer/timer.go#L32-L36>)

Styles are how the time left is painted in each state.

```go
type Styles struct {
    Running  lipgloss.Style
    Stopped  lipgloss.Style
    TimedOut lipgloss.Style
}
```

<a name="DefaultStyles"></a>
### func [DefaultStyles](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/timer/timer.go#L40>)

```go
func DefaultStyles(th theme.Resolved) Styles
```

DefaultStyles leaves a running timer plain, dims a stopped one and marks one that ran out as danger.

<a name="TickMsg"></a>
## type [TickMsg](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/timer/timer.go#L21-L24>)

TickMsg takes a step off the timer whose ID it carries. A host hands it on the way it hands on keys; a timer ignores every other timer's.

```go
type TickMsg struct {
    ID int64
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```
